notes.title: SuperEpic new Map Update!
notes.notes:
A new SuperEpic update is out now!

After a month of its original release and with all the great user feedback received, we're happy to announce that SuperEpic's first update is now available on Steam and it's coming soon to other platforms!

This update's main focus was to improve the in-game map's usability and include the much requested "reminder" option. With this feature players can add or remove a marker in the current room they're visiting, so they will remember there's something special to come back for later.

Here's an example of how this works:

[previewyoutube=nA8X0siAsAw;full][/previewyoutube]

This feature will work both on Story and Roguelite mode!

But that's not the only map-related improvement. We've also added new elevator icons, which now show the associated floor number, and a few other important markers, such as the HR lady!

A few other minor issues were fixed for a better overall experience. Thanks to all the reviewers and players for their valuable feedback! We hope you enjoy the new SuperEpic features!

Best wishes, 
The Undercoders and Numskull Games team
